headline: The 13 Nov Shorts were our best starts yet (955, 994 and 485 views in about two days), 28-35 s beats every other length, and most viewers who leave go at 5-6 seconds, on the second line.

working.text: Shorts of 28-35 s: median 385 views at 48 hours and 59.6% viewed (14 Shorts), against 52 views and 36.7% for 36 s and longer (21).
'Money at scale' stories: median 794 views at 48 hours and 40.3% stayed to watch (7 Shorts), against 107 for how-they-make-money (10) and 80 for billionaire questions (8).
'Secret' hooks: median 107 views at 48 hours and 66.7% viewed (14 Shorts); shock-number hooks 133 views (7).

notWorking.text: 'Question' hooks: median 32 views at 48 hours, 40.5% viewed and 26.4% stayed to watch (14 Shorts), the lowest of any hook style.
In 20 of the 26 Shorts of the last 3 weeks with drop points, the steepest fall came between 4.5 and 7 s, on the second line (often a wider total or a 'here is how it works' line).
Viewers don't subscribe: 99.5% of Short views in 28 days were from non-subscribers.

audience.text: 28 days: India 30.0%, US 25.1%, Philippines 10.1%, UK 6.8%, Indonesia 6.7% of views; US viewers watch 54.6% of a video, India 45.9%.
Mostly men: 25-34 male 33.4%, 35-44 male 14.4%, 18-24 male 14.1%, 13-17 male 12.1%; the largest female group is 35-44 at 9.8%.
Phones 82.8% and tablets 11.8% of Short views; 93.3% of all views came from the Shorts feed.

recommendations.do: Keep every Short 28-35 s about one event of a world-famous person or brand (one night, one deal, one year), the name and the figure in the title.
recommendations.because: 28-35 s Shorts got a median 385 views at 48 hours against 52 for longer ones, and the three 13 Nov Shorts of this kind got 485-994.

recommendations.do: Make the second line carry on the hook's own story (the next fact about the same person), never a wider total or an explanation of what is coming.
recommendations.because: 20 of 26 Shorts lost the most viewers at 4.5-7 s; the MrBeast Short lost 41 points at 5.3 s on the all-creators total.

recommendations.do: Stop question hooks; open on the secret or the figure itself.
recommendations.because: question hooks have a median 32 views at 48 hours (14 Shorts), against 107 for secret hooks (14) and 133 for shock numbers (7).
